title: About the studio
body:
Family-owned since 2005. Classes for children, teens and adults, including combination classes that teach several styles together.

Classes run September–June, with summer workshops and an annual June recital.

Teachers ↗Studio policies ↗Partners ↗
Parents & community

Parents can watch from the viewing area and join the Dance Institute Parent Organization. Students also perform at community events and retirement homes.

title: Studio policies
body:
Bring dance shoes and a closed water bottle. Dancewear is available at the studio.

Clothing & hair

Girls through age nine: black short-sleeve leotard and pink tights. Leotards and tights are the base attire; ballet skirts and dance pants for jazz, tap and hip-hop are welcome. Boys may wear dance pants and a T-shirt.

Avoid loose or baggy clothing. Secure hair away from the face; use a bun for long hair or pigtails for tumbling.

Classroom rules

Follow your teacher’s directions. No hanging on barres, gum or jewelry. Unsafe behavior may mean sitting out.

Watching class

Parents are welcome in the viewing area. Keep conversations outside the class.

title: Teachers
body:
Miss Michele

Michele began dancing at three and assisting with classes at fourteen. Her teaching combines technique with a playful approach for each age group.

Training & experience

At the University of Minnesota, Michele performed, choreographed and assisted with tap and ballroom courses. Her training includes ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop, modern, tumbling and ballroom.

title: The Nutcracker
body:
Auditions are open to dancers ages 8+. Call for dates, rehearsals and fees.

Call (303) 525-0011 ↗

View registration in Sawyer ↗

What to expect at auditions

Dancers learn a short ballet routine, then perform for the teaching panel individually or in small groups. Auditions determine role placement.

Wear fitted dance clothing and secure your hair. Rehearsal commitments depend on the role.

title: Privacy policy
description: Studio SMS privacy and messaging information.
body:
This page summarizes Dance Institute, LLC’s published SMS terms.

Information & use

SMS signup may collect your name, email, mailing address and phone number through forms, email, rental agreements or reservation systems. Data is used for studio service messages, stored securely and retained while subscribed. You may request deletion at any time.

Messages & charges

Messages recur at varying frequencies. Carrier message and data charges may apply. Carriers are not responsible for delayed or undelivered messages.

Help & opting out

Reply HELP for assistance. Reply STOP or UNSUBSCRIBE to opt out, or contact the studio at (303) 525-0011. The studio sends a final confirmation and removes your number within 24 hours.

Sharing

Mobile information is not shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing. SMS consent and opt-in information are not shared. Information may be shared with subcontractors providing support services.
